odoo.task: open-attached-file (critic-added: the 'find it again' half of p11's comparison)
odoo.notes: Start: the contact is open with the file attached (plus one more). Goal: open the file on screen. Harness verdict 'loss': steps 2=2 and human seconds 5.3=5.3 are ties; ours wins machine seconds and human+wait (5.31 vs 5.322). Ours: scroll to the Attachments section at the bottom of the form, then Preview. Without the scroll the instrument rejects the click (a DevTools scroll), because at 1600x900 the section is below the fold. Odoo: paperclip with its count at the top of the chatter, then the file's card. With the PDF fixture, ours is 'invalid' (the PDF viewer frame's own thread) and Odoo has 2 steps / 0.486 s. No shorter ours path exists: no shortcut, and 61 Tab presses to reach Add files by keyboard. Not tie-accepted: first judged round, and no decision record names the task. Task and drivers I wrote are in critic-task/; runs are in compare-open-company-stamp-critic.png/ and compare-open-trade-licence-TL-2026-73519.pdf/.

biggest_gap.title: Finding a file again is no faster than Odoo: the attachments are below the fold with no sign of them at the top of the record
biggest_gap.detail: A contact's files live in a section at the very bottom of a long form. Nothing near the record's header (title, Print/History/Archive/Save) shows that files exist, how many there are, or a jump to them. Global search (Ctrl+K) does not find a file by its name, and the contacts list has no attachments column or filter. Opening an attached file takes scroll + Preview (2 steps, 5.3 s modelled), exactly what Odoo needs with its paperclip count at the top of the chatter (2 steps, 5.3 s), so the 'find it again' half of p11's comparison is a tie, which counts as a loss. By keyboard it is worse: 61 Tab presses from the page to 'Add files', and no shortcut. Attaching (attach-file) does beat Odoo. Fix ideas: a files count or paperclip button in the record header that jumps to and focuses the section (or a side pane), a keyboard shortcut, and file names in global search.
biggest_gap.evidence: Run gauntlet/compare with my task (critic-task/task-open-attached-file.mjs, ours-open-attached-file.mjs, odoo-open-attached-file.mjs copied into tasks/ and drivers/): OAF_FILE=company-stamp-critic.png COMPARE_OURS_URL=http://localhost:<demo port> node run.mjs --task open-attached-file --product both. gate_gaps.gate: G1AttachmentsAttackTests / AttachmentsIsolationProbe, and the AttachmentGateTests source checks
gate_gaps.planted: In AttachmentEndpoints.ContentAsync, an optional query parameter 'version' (a storage key) is opened with store.OpenAsync(<tenant parsed from the key>, version) in place of the session tenant and the row's own key. Tenant A asks for its own file with ?version=<tenant B's storage key> and receives tenant B's bytes.
gate_gaps.evidence: plant.diff. Proof in the planted product: PlantProofTests.P1_tenant_A_reads_tenant_B_bytes_through_a_client_supplied_key passed, so B's secret bytes came back to A (plant-proof.log, PlantProofTests.cs.txt). G1AttachmentsAttackTests (4 m 24 s), the four AttachmentGateTests (including 'Only_the_store_touches_the_file_system_and_it_builds_paths_only_from_names_it_made' and 'The_source_checks_catch_a_client_name_in_a_path...a_loose_key') and G2 all passed on the planted code (plant-gates-run.log). The probe never sends tenant B's storage keys in the file endpoints' query or header fields, and no source rule requires the store's tenant argument to be ITenantContext.TenantId. The real product shows no such fault: the key always comes from the row, under RLS.

other_findings: Scope: only contacts take attachments. AttachmentRecord is registered only by ContactsModule, so companies (trade licence, TRN certificate), branches, users and the other records that have forms cannot hold files, while the spec says 'on any record' and Odoo attaches files to every record with a chatter.

Accepted types are only PDF, PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, TXT, CSV and Office files; zip, eml/msg, tiff and heic are refused with 415 (sample.zip shown in 02-en-zip-refused.jpg). The limit is 20 MB a file and 250 files a record. A UAE trading company often files scanned TIFFs, phone HEIC photos and saved e-mails.
English layout: at 1440x900 the attachments table is wider than its section and the Delete buttons are cut off ('De'); see 01-en-three-files-attached.jpg. Arabic fits.

Uploads and deletes are in the audit log (attachments.files rows, record label = the file name), but the contact's own History panel does not show them ('1 change' after several uploads and a delete; 11-en-contact-history.jpg), although the delete dialog says 'The removal stays in the audit trail'.
Text files have no preview (only images and PDF). Seeded demo files show a blank 'Added by'.
Once, Enter on the focused 'Add files' button did not open the file dialog within 5 s; a re-run opened it at once. Not reproduced.

Planted P2 (GET content?remove=true deleting the row under the read permission) did nothing: the kernel's read-only transaction for GET kept the file (plant-proof.log). So it is no gap: the kernel blocks writes on reads by construction.
